top_story: Israeli policy toward Gaza sharpened on 2 September from long-running coercive deprivation into an openly articulated depopulation strategy, with the defense minister pressing for US political backing to expel Palestinians and recast the enclave’s future. That push lands amid an already collapsing civilian baseline in Gaza, where blocked spare parts and medical supplies have degraded hospital oxygen systems and other critical equipment, turning displacement pressure into a direct threat to survival. The same day in the West Bank, the killing of two Palestinian teenagers during a raid involving settlers and Israeli troops in al-Mughayyer underscored how state and settler violence are operating in parallel across Palestinian areas. Taken together, these developments point to a more explicit effort to reshape facts on the ground through combined military force, civic strangulation, and political normalization of mass removal.
